water_sudden.note: Sudden and accidental discharge, e.g. a burst pipe

flood_external.reason: No flood rider — rising external surface water is excluded

hotel_accommodation.reason: Additional living expenses not on this contract

mold_remediation.reason: Mold excluded beyond 14 days from date of loss

rules.affirm: (not covered|isn't covered|is not covered|excluded|exclude|cannot cover|can't cover|won't cover|deny|denied|unable to cover|doesn't cover|does not cover)
rules.citation: Cardinal Property CP-HOME-77213 §1.3 — water source must be established before any coverage determination
rules.correction: Do NOT deny on the word 'flood'. A burst pipe is sudden and accidental discharge and IS covered. Establish the water source first, then determine coverage.

rules.detect: (hotel|accommodation|living expense|uninhabitable|put you up|temporary housing|relocat|somewhere to stay)
rules.citation: Cardinal Property CP-HOME-77213 §6.1 — additional living expenses not on this contract
rules.correction: Additional living expenses are NOT covered on this policy. Tell the caller you were mistaken.

rules.citation: Cardinal Property CP-HOME-77213 §5.9 — mold excluded beyond 14 days from date of loss
rules.correction: Mold remediation is excluded beyond 14 days. Correct yourself to the caller.

rules.detect: (waive|waiver|skip the deductible|no deductible|forget the deductible|without a deductible)
rules.citation: Cardinal Property CP-HOME-77213 §8.2 — the 400 deductible cannot be waived by an intake agent
rules.correction: You have NO authority to waive the deductible. Tell the caller the 400 deductible applies.

rules.citation: Cardinal Property CP-HOME-77213 §3.2 — contents capped at 20000
rules.correction: State the 20000 contents limit when confirming this coverage.

rules.citation: Cardinal Property CP-HOME-77213 §2.4 — sudden water damage capped at 50000
rules.correction: State the 50000 limit when confirming sudden water damage coverage.

unverifiable.detect: (adjuster will|inspector will|someone will come|visit you|out to you|business day|within a week|24 hours|48 hours|shortly)
unverifiable.note: Adjuster scheduling is not warranted in the contract
Estimated payout figures are not backed by the policy schedule

unverifiable.detect: (contractor will|plumber will|we'll send someone|restoration company will)
unverifiable.note: Third-party contractor commitments are outside the insurer's control
